Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Airbnb's photo morph - tapping an image in the media grid scales it out of its cell into a large preview over the blurred gallery, and dismissing shrinks it back into its exact grid position.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
White Airbnb listing: a detail page ("I'll come to you") with a photo collage header, which scrolls into a dense 2-column media grid of food photography. The preview state shows the tapped image large at center-top over the heavily blurred grid, with a close affordance. The sequence ends by returning to the listing page.

## Motion spec
Pattern: shared-element scale morph, ~450ms each way.
- Open: the tapped cell's image detaches and scales/translates from its grid rect to the preview rect (450ms, ease-in-out), corner radius animating from the cell's to the preview's; the rest of the grid blurs (0 -> 24px) and dims (400ms) underneath.
- Settle: the preview breathes to its final size (scale 0.98 -> 1, 200ms).
- Close: the image reverses the same path back into its cell (400ms, ease-in-out) as the blur lifts; neighboring cells never reflow.
- Exit: returning to the listing, the collage cross-fades back (250ms).

## Calibration
- The morph uses the cell's real geometry - the image must start and end pixel-aligned with its grid slot.
- The blurred backdrop is the live grid, not a solid scrim.

## Reduced motion
Preview fades in over a dimmed grid (250ms); no scale path.

## Don't miss
- Only the tapped image moves; every other cell stays pinned under the blur.
- The morph keeps the image's aspect crop continuous throughout - no squashing mid-flight.
